'''Hospital Plaza''' was an area of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained the [[Galactic Senate Medcenter/Legends|Galactic Senate Medcenter]] and was adjacent to [[Nicandra Plaza]].
